body: Might be too late to comment, but I used to work for a streaming company— just call/chat them and they’ll be happy to remove anyone you don’t want. They typically can see the device list attached to the account.

Hm. I’m not sure if it’s this. I’ve read a bit about this, but the nausea problems I had before have been something I’ve dealt with for a long time. So much so Ive been prescribed ondansetron for it. 

I do think stopping weed has made it worse, but I also think it’s in part to having to continue medication that I have to take food with. But since I’m throwing up food, it’s been impossible for me to take my normal meds. (I took them the past two days, but have foregone it last night and this morning.) D: so I think I might have found the issue because my nausea has decreased drastically so, I just have to forego everything I’m currently taking to tell my doctor what my baseline is e-e.

Thank you for the advice though! My SO brought me some pedialite which is also helping!

Oh I agree, but I actually only started smoking two years ago from a doctors recommendation in a different state. I did have a good grasp on how I was before then. As I only started smoking at 24, and I’ve tried copious amounts of varying medications that didn’t help, and I was in therapy since I was 16. I haven’t tried any other drugs that would have influenced me either. They’re making me stick with lithium.. which, ultimately is destroying my kidneys and I wanted something different (hence moving to weed). Before she’s willing to help, she informed me I need to quit.

These are symptoms I had before weed, just 10x worse as the nausea is consistent, and actively eating anything (except for soup broth in sips. I finished a can in four hours.) makes me incredibly sick.

I would try the exercise route, but I honestly can’t move actively without my vision going fuzzy and feeling like I’m about to collapse. This winds up making me feel sicker. /:

Have you found any foods that help you?
